Remove ONLY its entire textured orange/gold rectangular background. Preserve the exact dark near-black compass rose / four-point navigational star outline, its internal ring, asymmetrical spear points, line widths, orientation, proportions, and all original icon geometry. Output that same single dark compass ornament isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background, tightly framed with a small transparent margin. It is a small button icon and will be shown at 36px. Do not redesign, add points, add a button, add text, add shadows, add a gold rectangle, recolor the icon, or draw a checkerboard.

notes: All art is sliced from the existing generated reference. No full-screen reference background is produced.
Slot crops contain original quantity glyphs: cover quantityRect with an opaque UI patch and render native variable text.
Header branding is explicitly decorative raster lettering; other body/button text is native and editable.
Frame centers are zero RGBA, not hidden copies of reference controls. Buttons reconstruct their semantic center from a blank texture crop.
Rectangles are integer source-pixel bounds chosen from the visible reference; first-pass visual review is still required.
scope: Reference crops and masked UI skins retain exact unmasked source pixels. Additional adaptive alpha ornaments use separately recorded image-generation background extraction; they are not pixel-identical original layers. Visual fidelity and runtime integration remain to be verified.
